column1: # Stage S11 J1b — the ticketboard's headless half becomes the ticketboard_model crate under
# tools/tickets: every feature's models, services and events, the execution metrics' measured and
# estimated halves, the process and clock helpers, the egui-free application state (events,
# workspace state and reload, window layout, background loading) and the shared test fixtures. The
# egui views, the eframe application and main.rs stay in apps/ticketboard.
# The crate root, the prelude, the module roots and the READMEs of the new folders are written by
# hand. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# the registry feature has no view: the whole folder moves
# each viewed feature: its README, events, models and services move; mod.rs and ui/ stay
# the subprocess and clock helpers; core/ui stays
# the egui-free application files become the application_state module
# the shared test fixtures and the source inspection the architecture tests read with
# the ticketboard's imports of the moved modules name the new crate
